title: International Graduate Student Scholarship (IGSS)
official_source: Universiti Putra Malaysia (UPM), School of Graduate Studies
duration: Up to 3 years (to the 6th semester), reviewed annually
description: The School of Graduate Studies of Universiti Putra Malaysia awards the International Graduate Student Scholarship (IGSS) as a 30-50% tuition fee waiver for PhD students from Southeast Asia, South Asia, Central Asia, the Middle East and Africa. Funding covers up to three years (to the sixth semester) and is subject to an annual review of the student's academic progress. Priority is given to applicants from developing countries where UPM holds strategic importance and to staff of institutions with an MoU or MoA with UPM. Applicants must hold a master's degree, must not hold any other scholarship

title: APU International Students Scholarships & Merit Awards 2026
program_type: University merit scholarship / tuition fee award
duration: Annual award, renewable each academic year while minimum CGPA 2.50 is maintained
description: Asia Pacific University Malaysia offers international students tuition fee awards described as Merit Awards, which are fee awards leading to rebates or discounts. title: Fu Jen Catholic University Scholarship for New International Students (Doctoral Degree Programs)
duration: Eight consecutive semesters for doctoral degree programmes, beginning in the semester of admission; for undergraduate and Master's programmes the university publishes different, shorter terms (see notes)
description: Fu Jen Catholic University's International Student Admissions Office publishes a set of Fu Jen-funded scholarships for newly admitted international students. title: Chula LINK Scholarship 2026
official_source: Chulalongkorn University (Office of International Affairs and Global Network)
duration: Awarded for the second semester of academic year 2026 as published; the call page does not state a longer award period
description: The Chulalongkorn Leaders in International Networks and Knowledge (Chula LINK) Scholarship for International Students supports international Master's and doctoral students at Chulalongkorn University for the second semester of academic year 2026, and includes tuition fees, a monthly living allowance and round-trip airfare.

title: TDTU Scholarship for International Students (2026-2027 Academic Year)
program_type: University-funded admission scholarship (tuition waiver and dormitory fee)
duration: 04-05 years for undergraduate programmes taught in English, according to the major; 1 compulsory year of Vietnamese language study followed by 04-05 years for programmes taught in Vietnamese
description: Ton Duc Thang University publishes an annual TDTU Scholarship scheme for international undergraduate applicants, with awards ranging from partial to full depending on academic performance and language proficiency. Under the full scholarship a holder pays no undergraduate tuition fee and no dormitory fee; under the partial scholarship the tuition fee is 50-75% covered and the dormitory fee is still fully covered.
